fields.name: access_key
fields.help: accessKey issued by Yoycol for OPEN API V4 (sent as X-API-Access-Key).

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: secretKey issued with it; signs every request (Base64 HMAC-SHA256 over method, path, timestamp, nonce, accessKey, algorithm, version and the sorted query). Never sent on the wire.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one catalogue product (GET /api/2025/open/v4/catalog/products?page=1&size=1). Auth failures come back as codes 300001-300010 in the body.

list_products.note: List Products (Catalog): Yoycol print-on-demand blanks {id, spuCode, name, spuDisplayImg, onlineStatus, variantCount}; `query` is a fuzzy name keyword; `category` is not supported. No prices in the list — use get_product.

get_product.note: Get Product with include=variants: product {id, spuCode, name, spuDisplayImg} and variants[{id, skuCode, size, color, weight, salesPrice, currency, onlineStatus}] in `raw`; mapped price/sku are the first variant's. A variant skuCode is what quote_shipping takes.

quote_shipping.note: Get Sku Quotes: `product_id` must be a variant skuCode (from get_product). Returns every shipping region with its logistics levels [{levelCode, levelName, firstPrice, additionalPrice, timeEffectPriority}]; `country` and `quantity` are not inputs of this endpoint — pick the region and compute firstPrice + (quantity-1) x additionalPrice.

not_offered.create_order: POST /api/2025/open/v4/orders has no query string, and the V4 signatureData appends '\nparams=<sorted query>' only 'if (paramStr)' (Signature Guide, https://www.yoycol.com/api/2025/redoc, Docs Guide section); the runtime's sign payload is one fixed template, so a request with no query string would be signed with a trailing empty params line and rejected.
not_offered.get_order: GET /api/2025/open/v4/orders/{orderId} has no query parameters, and the V4 signatureData appends '\nparams=<sorted query>' only 'if (paramStr)' (Signature Guide, https://www.yoycol.com/api/2025/redoc, Docs Guide section); the runtime's sign payload is one fixed template, so a request with no query string would be signed with a trailing empty params line and rejected.
not_offered.track: GET /api/2025/open/v4/orders/{orderId}/tracking has no query parameters, and the V4 signatureData appends '\nparams=<sorted query>' only 'if (paramStr)' (Signature Guide, https://www.yoycol.com/api/2025/redoc, Docs Guide section); the runtime's sign payload is one fixed template, so a request with no query string would be signed with a trailing empty params line and rejected.
